name: Facet
text: Add a single, prominent button labeled “Live Refresh” that toggles continuous playback of the visualization. This keeps the interface clean while giving users direct control over when updates happen. The trade-off is that users must remember to enable it—automatic refresh would feel more seamless, but it risks overwhelming the screen when many changes occur.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A single toggle risks users missing the live mode entirely—defaults matter. Better: default to live, with a clear "Pause" button; that settles it by measuring how often users manually pause.
